description: Theme selection: color mode and theme (a swatch grid, or one select when compact), as a popover or inline panel

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: popover: trigger + floating panel; inline: always-visible panel

attributes.name: compact
attributes.description: Theme chooser is one grouped <select> instead of the swatch grid (the smallest form)

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Reflected state only — set by open()/close()/toggle(), not intended as initial markup (popover variant only)

attributes.name: data-label-mode
attributes.description: Color mode legend and radiogroup label (i18n override)

attributes.name: data-label-theme
attributes.description: Legend and accessible name of the theme chooser

childAttributes.name: data-trigger
childAttributes.description: Marks the popover trigger (else the first child <button>; else a generated type=button icon trigger)

methods.name: open()
methods.description: Open the popover and move focus into it (popover variant only)
